what_it_does: Intel's Granite Rapids-D is a server processor optimized for wireless networks, edge data centers, and storage systems. The chip comes in two versions: one tuned for high-performance computing with fast memory and many high-speed data ports, and another hardened to operate in harsh outdoor or industrial conditions (temperatures from -40°C to 85°C with rapid swings). Both versions include built-in security features that create a protected walled-off area (trusted execution environment) for sensitive AI workloads, plus connections for accelerators and high-speed networking.
